entries.text: 修复 SQL Server 表定义解析的缺陷
entries.textEn: Fixed SQL Server table definition parsing

entries.text: SQL Server 支持 [varchar](20) 形式的数据类型定义
entries.textEn: SQL Server: [varchar](20) datatype declarations

entries.text: SQL Server 支持 db..tab 形式的表名引用
entries.textEn: SQL Server: db..tab table references

entries.text: SQL Server 支持在 CREATE TABLE 内联定义非聚集索引
entries.textEn: SQL Server: inline non-clustered index definitions in CREATE TABLE

entries.text: 修复文件起始位置为分隔符时的解析错误
entries.textEn: Fixed parsing when a file starts with a separator

entries.text: 扩充 SQL Server 语法支持：set col1 += col2、insert into table exec、char(max)、百分数常量、UNIQUEIDENTIFIER、类型方法调用 abc::method() 等
entries.textEn: Expanded SQL Server syntax: set col1 += col2, insert into table exec, char(max), percentage literals, UNIQUEIDENTIFIER, type method calls abc::method() and more

entries.text: SQL Server 支持 columnstore 索引、table/query hint 与 remote 表引用
entries.textEn: SQL Server: columnstore indexes, table/query hints and remote table references

entries.text: 支持基于 cursor 的数据操作（delete/update），过程、触发器与函数解析更健壮
entries.textEn: Cursor-based data modification (delete/update), with more robust procedure, trigger and function parsing

entries.text: 支持触发器解析，并优化不重要文本的解析
entries.textEn: Added trigger parsing and improved parsing of insignificant text

entries.text: 每个 SQL 解析开始时初始化表对象栈
entries.textEn: The table-object stack is initialised at the start of each parse

entries.text: 脚本解析中只有一个表且列未加表名前缀时，把该列归属到该表
entries.textEn: In script parsing, an unqualified column with a single table is assigned to that table

entries.text: 修复视图解析与审核优化的缺陷
entries.textEn: Fixed view parsing and audit optimisation

entries.text: 支持 Oracle 与 PostgreSQL 标识符中使用 $
entries.textEn: Identifiers may contain $ on Oracle and PostgreSQL

entries.text: SQL 审核支持 tsql 脚本
entries.textEn: SQL review supports TSQL scripts

entries.text: 修复 SQL Server 临时表与自增列解析的缺陷
entries.textEn: Fixed SQL Server temporary-table and identity-column parsing

entries.text: 子查询中有多个表引用且同属一个表连接时不做查询折叠
entries.textEn: No query folding when a subquery's table references belong to one join

entries.text: 审核视图定义中的 SQL，而不是视图本身
entries.textEn: The SQL inside a view definition is reviewed, not the view itself

entries.text: 修复「索引列上的运算导致索引失效」规则在 ifnull 场景下的缺陷
entries.textEn: Fixed the index-invalidating-expression rule for ifnull

entries.text: 「避免无条件的 DML 操作」规则在基于 cursor 的操作下不再触发
entries.textEn: The unconditional-DML rule no longer fires for cursor-based operations

entries.text: 修复 afterRules 调用的缺陷
entries.textEn: Fixed the afterRules invocation

entries.text: 针对临时表排除一批审查规则（IfExists、命名规范、注释要求、主键要求等）
entries.textEn: Excluded a set of audit rules for temporary tables (IfExists, naming conventions, required comments, required primary keys and others)

entries.text: 修复函数或表达式中的列未作为 indexonly 候选的索引推荐缺陷
entries.textEn: Fixed index recommendation missing columns wrapped in functions or expressions as index-only candidates

entries.text: 没有索引时不展示索引分析段落
entries.textEn: The index analysis section is hidden when there are no indexes

entries.text: 修复候选索引合并的缺陷，以及存在内生表时 join 列的索引推荐
entries.textEn: Fixed candidate-index merging and join-column index recommendation with nested tables

entries.text: 选择列是 * 但查询块为 exists 子查询时，仍可作为 indexonly 候选
entries.textEn: A * select list can still be an index-only candidate inside an exists subquery
